summary: The C-01 problem-type recommendations screen now satisfies the approved wireframe and hifi intent for this audit. It keeps the workspace learning navigation, presents the fixed 51/52/53/54 type tabs, preserves the recommendation card region even when the current seed has no recommendation items, and shows four direct type-selection cards with clear metadata and start links. The page renders stably at 360, 768, and 1280 widths with no Next error overlay or console errors.
acceptedVariance: The current audit seed returns a recommendation run reason but no active recommendation_items for the page. Instead of dropping into a sparse empty state, the screen uses a fallback recommendation panel for the selected/default type while retaining the existing primary recommendation card path when items are present.
The hifi includes an illustrated mascot. The current screen uses icon-based learning visuals and card metadata rather than introducing a new mascot asset dependency.
Next dev indicator may appear in local screenshots. It is not product UI and is excluded from visual severity.

findings.claim: Resolved: the route renders inside the authenticated learning workspace navigation.
findings.observed: The desktop, tablet, and mobile captures show the workspace shell and active learning navigation context.
findings.expected: The C-01 wireframe requires the learning side-navigation context to stay visible for this recommendation page.

findings.claim: Resolved: the type filter is fixed to the documented 51/52/53/54 writing types.
findings.observed: DOM inspection confirms four tab labels: 51, 52, 53, and 54. The visual capture shows a stable segmented tab strip.
findings.expected: The wireframe requires four fixed TOPIK writing type tabs with a clear selected state.

findings.claim: Resolved: the recommendation card region remains visually dominant even when recommendation_items are empty.
findings.observed: The fallback panel shows a representative type, run-level reason summary, estimated time, difficulty, ready status, and a start CTA. When data exists, the existing PrimaryRecommendationCard path still renders the real item.
findings.expected: The wireframe and hifi require a large recommended problem/type card with recommendation reason and primary action.

findings.claim: Resolved: the direct type selection area presents four clear, scannable type cards.
findings.observed: DOM inspection confirms four type cards and four writing links. Each card includes type label, short description, expected minutes, difficulty, and start affordance.
findings.expected: The C-01 wireframe requires a maximum of four direct type-selection cards with clear selected/available state and concise descriptions.

findings.claim: Resolved: the recommendation page renders cleanly across audited breakpoints.
findings.observed: render-shot captured 360, 768, and 1280 viewports with status 200, errorOverlay=false, and consoleErr=0. Scoped Playwright C-01 e2e passed on mobile-360, tablet-768, and desktop-1280.
findings.expected: The authenticated recommendation route should render without redirect loops, error overlays, console errors, text collisions, or horizontal overflow across audited breakpoints.
